appraisal_events.evidence: sa trop grande facilité à faire à de jolies veuves... à des comtesses de nom ronflant... la politesse de les présenter à ma grand'mère ou même à leur donner des bijoux de famille, l'avait déjà brouillé plus d'une fois avec mon grand-père.
appraisal_events.explanation: Oncle Adolphe's easy familiarity with actresses and demimondaines, and his habit of treating them as if presentable to the family, has repeatedly caused open friction with the narrator's grandfather, marking him as socially compromised within the family's eyes; his careful avoidance of introducing the narrator properly to the woman present, or naming her, confirms his own awareness of the impropriety.

status_effects.explanation: Oncle Adolphe is locally diminished by the association with actresses and demimondaines that has repeatedly caused rifts with the family, and by his own furtive handling of the visit.
